title: 人体对地电阻
source_doc: course/Electrical Safety Series/19_Human Body Earth Resistance What Is The Human Body Earth Resistance HSE STUDY GU.md
author_source: project/Electrical Safety Series/19_Human Body Earth Resistance What Is The Human Body Earth Resistance HSE STUDY GU/src.py

points.K1: 面试常问：人体电阻多少
points.K4: 依据：美国机构，潮湿约一千欧
points.K6: 人体会成为电流入地的通路

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上画着一个空白的人形轮廓
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard with a simple blank human outline drawn on it and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课聊聊人体电阻。

shots.scene: 人形图标、电阻符号、水滴三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a human pictogram, a resistor symbol and a water droplet. No people.
shots.narration: 它有多大，湿了又会怎样。

shots.scene: 阿杰刚洗完手，湿着手伸向仪器的电源开关
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, hands still dripping after washing, reaches toward the power switch of a lab instrument.
shots.narration: 阿杰洗完手，湿着手就去开仪器。

shots.scene: 小研递给他一张擦手纸，指了指他的手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands him a paper towel and points at his wet hands.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：先把手擦干。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，一脸不解
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a puzzled look, holding the paper towel.
shots.narration: 阿杰不解：人不是有电阻吗？

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of the whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 这个电阻，可没你想的那么大。

shots.section_title: 面试常问：人体电阻多少
shots.scene: 面试场景：王老师坐在桌后，阿杰坐在对面
shots.prompt_en: An interview scene: the safety administrator sits behind a desk with blank papers, the young male student sits across.
shots.narration: 安全岗位面试，常会问到这个问题。
overlay: 面试常问：人体电阻多少

shots.section_title: 面试常问：人体电阻多少
shots.scene: 阿杰面前浮现一个问号气泡
shots.prompt_en: A big question mark bubble floats above the young male student's head.
shots.narration: 人体电阻大约是多少？

shots.scene: 白板上四张空白卡片排成一列
shots.prompt_en: Four blank answer cards in a column on a whiteboard, each with a small letter circle. No people.
shots.narration: 四个选项，选一个。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标，卡片旁有思考气泡
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon beside the four answer cards and a thought bubble. No people.
shots.narration: 先想一想，你会选哪个？

shots.scene: 第四张卡片亮起，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The fourth answer card lights up with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是D，大约一千欧。

shots.scene: 前三张卡片变灰
shots.prompt_en: The first three answer cards turn gray and fade. No people.
shots.narration: 前三个数都太小了。

shots.section_title: 依据：美国机构，潮湿约一千欧
shots.scene: 一只湿手图标，水滴往下滴
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wet hand with water droplets dripping down. No people.
shots.narration: 潮湿条件下，人体电阻约一千欧。
overlay: 依据：美国机构，潮湿约一千欧

shots.section_title: 依据：美国机构，潮湿约一千欧
shots.scene: 空白文件夹图标，旁边地球图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank document folder icon next to a small globe icon. No people.
shots.narration: 依据美国国家职业安全卫生研究所。

shots.scene: 干燥的手图标，电阻符号变大
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a dry hand next to a resistor symbol that grows larger. No people.
shots.narration: 皮肤干燥时，电阻会更高。

shots.scene: 湿手和干手两个图标，中间一个大于号
shots.prompt_en: A dry hand icon and a wet hand icon side by side with a greater-than sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 一沾水，电阻就降下来。

shots.section_title: 人体会成为电流入地的通路
shots.scene: 简化电路：电源、开关、灯泡，一个简笔人手碰导线
shots.prompt_en: A simple circuit diagram: power source, switch and a light bulb; a stick figure touches the live wire. No people.
shots.narration: 人碰到带电导线，
overlay: 人体会成为电流入地的通路

shots.section_title: 人体会成为电流入地的通路
shots.scene: 黄色箭头从手经身体流到脚下的接地符号
shots.prompt_en: A yellow arrow runs from the stick figure's hand through its body down to a ground symbol at its feet. No people.
shots.narration: 电流就会经过人体流入大地。

shots.section_title: 人体会成为电流入地的通路
shots.scene: 电阻符号变小，电流箭头变粗
shots.prompt_en: A resistor symbol shrinks while the current arrow beside it grows thicker and red. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻越小，流过人体的电流越大。

shots.section_title: 人体会成为电流入地的通路
shots.scene: 湿手图标旁电流箭头变粗
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wet hand next to a current arrow that grows thicker. No people.
shots.narration: 潮湿时电阻低，电流就更大。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现湿手和电阻图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a wet hand and a small resistor symbol.
shots.narration: 潮湿时人体电阻只有约一千欧。

shots.scene: 电阻变小、电流变大的箭头
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a shrinking resistor and a growing current arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻越小，触电越危险。

shots.scene: 面试桌和打绿勾的D选项卡片
shots.prompt_en: An interview desk icon next to answer card D with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 面试再问到，记住答案选D。

shots.scene: 欣欣用毛巾擦干手，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot dries its paws with a towel and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 擦干双手再用电，下次见！
